name: auction-tracker-desktop
description: Electron desktop wrapper for Auction Tracker
author: Jordan Hymas

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build:frontend:electron: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build:electron && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:electron && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:mac:zip: npm run build:electron && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac zip
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:electron && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:zip: npm run build:electron && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win zip
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:electron && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir --publish never
